_comment: Reference pay-as-you-go list prices for converting recorded usage; NOT an invoice. The services currently run on the Free (F0) tier. The single place where prices live: reports read this file, usage rows never hold a price. Add a new entry (never edit an old one) when Microsoft changes a price; the entry whose effective_from is the latest not after the usage date applies.
